name: @tradew/database
description: Single Prisma schema + migration history — the one schema owner for Postgres (ARCHITECTURE.md §1.4). Also owns the at-rest encryption format for BrokerCredential.accessToken (src/credential-crypto.ts).

scripts.//build: Prisma Client (node_modules/.prisma/client) is a build artifact separate from this package's own dist/, generated only by `prisma generate` — tsc never touches it. Before 2026-09-06 nothing tied the two together: schema.prisma could gain a model (e.g. UniverseInstrument) and dist/ could gain a new src/ export (e.g. listShippedMigrations) while the last-generated Prisma Client and the last tsc build silently kept neither, because `build` here only ran tsc. services/api then compiled against a stale client missing the new model AND a stale dist/index.js missing the new export — 37 TS errors, API exits before binding :4000. `generate` now always runs first so a plain `npm run build -w @tradew/database` (or the root postinstall, or predev:api) can never produce a dist/ that is out of sync with either schema.prisma or src/.
scripts.//build:if-stale: Same outcome as `build`, but a no-op when schema.prisma/src haven't changed since the last build. Used by predev:api instead of `build` because `npm run start:all` boots several services concurrently that all load the generated Prisma Client into their own process — an unconditional `prisma generate` there collides with a sibling service already holding query_engine-windows.dll.node open (Windows EPERM on rename). See scripts/build-if-stale.mjs.
scripts.//admin:reconcile: Withdraw application-admin access in bulk. Audit-only with no arguments; dry-run with --keep; writes only with --apply. Cleanup for the unfiltered updateMany in the removed create-admin.ts, which made every account an admin. Never grants — that stays admin:grant.
scripts.//agents:seed: Create the NIFTY and SENSEX autonomous paper agents, DISARMED. Arming stays a separate console act on top of PAPER_EXECUTION_ENABLED.
scripts.//credential:migrate: Backfill: encrypt any BrokerCredential.accessToken still stored in plaintext. Dry-run by default — see scripts/encrypt-broker-credentials.ts.
